description:
***Be sure to click "Video" button above on first picture at the top of the page.***

Custom built, centre hall plan Georgian is a rare gem located in the heart of north Leaside. With almost 4,000 sqft of living space, this 5 bedroom, 5 bathroom luxury dream home caters to a formal entertainer’s needs, but also has an open concept family space for everyday living. The house was attentively built and lovingly maintained by its original builder-owner. Flooded with natural light, soaring ceilings, solid red oak hardwood floors and intricate millwork, this house was designed to impress while preserving functionality. 

The primary features spare no expense with a 23 foot gourmet kitchen by Selba, top-of-the-line Stainless Steel appliances, Granite counter tops throughout, 2 fireplaces, a home office, and a reclaimed barn wood feature wall. An enormous 226-sqft master bedroom with a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-like 6-piece ensuite master bathroom which boasts an elongated Jacuzzi Tub, Pierre Deco top-of-the-line Aquamassage Tower Shower with two rain forest shower heads, six body jets and a waterfall, that provide a decadent environment for your morning ablutions. A 2-person, iComfort, carbon-film infra-red sauna rounds out the creature comforts of this 6-Star home.

A rare 2-car tandem garage provides your vehicles a safe and warm place to rest at night. The driveway can accommodate an additional two vehicles.

An electrically-powered, 425-sqft garden suite designed as a replica of the Coates/Cartwright Ontario Heritage stone house (c1850) can be used as a garden suite, she-shed/man-cave or simply storage. You choose. Either way, this beautiful building is easy on the eyes.

Professionally landscaped, a giant entertainer's deck, a 60-foot back yard, an automated, in-ground Sprinkler System, a robust Security System (monitoring extra) and tons of storage only scratch the surface of the long list of extras.

In addition to the above, the listing includes all electric light fixtures, window coverings, Washer, Dryer, Central Vacuum system (with attachments), High-efficiency gas, forced air furnace, central air conditioner and 75-gallon hot water heater.

Walking distance to: Children's Garden Nursery School, Maria Montessori School, Northlea Primary School (JK-8), Leaside High School (9-12), Crosstown LRT (scheduled completion September 2022) and the renown Leaside shops & restaurants.

Too many extras to list. Pre-Sale Home Inspection Report by Carson Dunlop available. Ask the agent for additional documents, if you'd like more information:

Or access them yourself: 

https://1drv.ms/f/s!AHXbcWBD1u4Cfw
(Highlight and copy the tiny URL above, then paste into your browser)

Within the Document Access Folder, you will find:
(1) A detailed Feature Sheet
(2) A detailed "Walk-Though" of the Property
(3) Leaside Neighbourhood Guide
(4) Carson Dunlop Certification

4 bedroom, 2+1 bath house, in-ground pool, in-ground pool, sunny south courtyard, garage, nestled at the top of the wooded neighborhood of Sherwood.Fully renovated high-end property in 2012 offering a balance between comfort and serenity. 2km/5 min by car from the Kirkland REM/34 min from McGill Station. Neighboring Windermere Park, schools and hospitals.Maintained since 1991 by the seller, it is turnkey with a bright open area, kitchen with quartz and marble counters. Landscaped courtyard with pool and terraces, very private, in a safe area without traffic.
            Refined living spaces:
            * Large open area: Inviting and bathed in light, showcasing superb hardwood floors.
            * High-end kitchen: Contemporary design with marble dinette counter, quartz surfaces and noble materials, perfect for receptions.
            * Dining room: A fluid transition space to the outdoor terrace thanks to its elegant solid wood patio doors.
            * Master bedroom: A true sanctuary with adjoining private bathroom and large glass shower with a clean design.
            * Four spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, a completely renovated shower room, one of which has heated floors.
            A private outdoor oasis:
            * South courtyard: Beautifully landscaped and lined with mature trees, creating an oasis of peace without any vis-à-vis.
            * Relaxation areas: Inground pool, vast cedar deck and concrete patio, designed to take full advantage of outdoor living.
            Technical details and conveniences:
            * The roof and all the high quality doors and windows were changed in 2012.
            * Optimal comfort: natural gas heating (high efficiency) and central air conditioning.
            * Integrated single garage and double entrance partly in paving stone.
            * Finished basement with custom storage and cedar closet.
            Inclusions: Pool accessories and maintenance, gas oven, gas oven, washer-dryer, refrigerator, dishwasher, curtains and poles, light fixtures (except exclusion). Living room bay window cushions. PVC wall-mounted garage organization system with brackets
            Exclusions: Furniture and personal effects, lighting in the dining room.
